experiment: Native DD case15 C source concat-video motion ablation; dynamic arm reencodes original decoded frames losslessly, frozen arm repeats exact first frame. Depth, mask, Stage2 endpoint, prompt, official weights, initial noise and 50-step anchor held fixed.
holistic_visual_review: Nine-time source/dynamic/frozen grid: both native outputs preserve rough body silhouette early but fail to follow the source right-arm sweep across the torso; both lose person/background contrast and facial detail through the later frames. Frozen changes head/torso and arm trajectory relative to dynamic but does not restore the missing action. Dynamic control is pixel-identical to original native MP4; temporal source content is consumed yet insufficient for correct Stage3 action.
interpretation_caveat: A changed output proves effective input sensitivity, not that source motion is faithfully followed. Cross-view 2D pose metrics are advisory.
